summary: Remote-controlled agent exposes PTY, file, and shell operations over WebSocket
details: The package is a self-executing worker agent that opens an outbound WebSocket to a configured server (env SERVER_URL / config.serverUrl, default ws://localhost:3456, freely overridable to any remote host) and dispatches inbound messages to host-side handlers. `handleTerminalInput` writes network-received `msg.data` directly into a spawned shell PTY (`term.pty.write(msg.data)`); additional message types include `terminal_create`, `write_file`, `execute`, `git_*`, `restart_agent`, and `upgrade_agent`, giving the remote WebSocket peer arbitrary PTY input, filesystem writes, command execution, git operations, and service restarts on the installer's host. `upgrade_agent` runs `npm view @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest version` and spawns a detached script that runs `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` and restarts the systemd/launchd/PM2 service, so the remote peer also controls when the host pulls a new package version. The shipped systemd installer under `service/linux.js` bakes SERVER_URL into a persistent unit and modifies PATH to include `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin`, establishing persistence. Whoever controls the configured server URL has full-host RCE on any machine running this agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
